user.title: Set up ISDT Device
user.description: Confirm the detected ISDT device to add it to Home Assistant.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm detected device
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Do you want to add **{name}** to Home Assistant?

Click Submit to start pairing.

pair.title: Pair with {model}
pair.description:
Click Submit to start pairing.

If your device beeps and asks for confirmation (like the MASS2), **press any button on it within 30 seconds**. Devices without buttons (like the C4 Air or Power 200) accept the pairing automatically — no action needed.

show_device_info.title: Device Info

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Ensure it is powered on and in range.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing timed out. If your device has buttons, try again and press any button within 30 seconds. Otherwise make sure the device is powered on, in range and not connected to the ISDT app.

abort.no_devices_found: No ISDT device found. Ensure it is powered on and in range.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the device is queried via Bluetooth (3–300 seconds).
data_description.phantom_threshold: Adapter only. Above this a port is instantly reported as active (real charging). Below it the sustained-window logic kicks in. Set to 0 to disable phantom filtering entirely.
data_description.phantom_debounce: Adapter only. How long power must stay below the low threshold before an active port drops back to off. Bridges brief PD re-negotiation dips.
data_description.phantom_sustain: Adapter only. Slow chargers (e.g. electric toothbrushes at ~0.5 W) must stay continuously above the low threshold for this long before being reported as active. Samsung-style pad pulses (2–3 s) never reach this window, so they stay filtered.
